notes.title: Patch Notes V2.1
notes.content:
Based on player feedback and internal testing, we have procedurally uploaded small patches post full release. The following contains a summary of the changes.

- Fixed minor key binding issues.
- Reduced sniper scope shake in easy and medium difficulties
- Tutorial message interrupts during first mission will be less frequent
- Not being able to sprint after a sniper headshot
- Enemy difficulty balancing
- Animation bug when carrying dead bodies
- Animation issues on lower frame rates
- Other minor fixes and balancing changes

tags.balance_change: - Reduced sniper scope shake in easy and medium difficulties

tags.bug: - Not being able to sprint after a sniper headshot
- Animation bug when carrying dead bodies
- Animation issues on lower frame rates

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.9
notes.content:
[b]Patch notes[/b]

[list]
[*] Game Difficulty can be changed in the middle of a mission, without having to restart the mission. The Mission will be considered completed in the lowest difficulty played.
[*] Easy difficulty made easier.
[*] Mission score calculation bug fixes.
[*] Explosion particle effect scale bug fix.
[*] AI bug fixes.
[*] Other general improvements and fixes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39661270/355b87a698c3db920ec9b5ca73dfe269789720af.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*] Dead enemies can now be carried and dropped with "X". Movement speed is reduced.

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.2
notes.content:
[b]Bugs:[/b]
	
-Enemy AI change – reduced enemies shooting at walls
-Skill points not calculated properly on 2nd playthrough
-Floating in prone, going fast in prone
-Sniper training mission – round one
-Communication Tower building railing collision
-“Sniper ammo limited” message error
-Few places where the player got stuck
-Other minor changes


[b]Gameplay and balancing:[/b]

-Pressing Jump key while in prone makes the player go to crouch
-Difficulty of mission one final shootout reduced
-Minor enemy placement changes in Prison Escape map

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.1
notes.content:
[b]Bugs:[/b]

- Fixed possible checkpoint save bugs when stuck in a loading screen. Progress will no longer be lost.
- Collisions of tower buildings fixed.
- Trucks physics asset fixed.
- Submerged enemies on ground issue fixed at some places

[b]Gameplay and Balancing:[/b]

- Pistol Headshot distance increased.
- Some issues in skill point calculations are fixed.
- Added ammunition crates in key locations.
